description: The shared Plexus update-bot preset (§ 9.1 PLX); a tenant repo extends it with one line.
Unattended merging is stratified by blast radius: packages merge on green CI, the release train always waits for a human.

copier.description: The hosted bot cannot run `copier update`; the release train's ship step owns template propagation.

packageRules.description: npm ranges follow the version actually tested; other managers keep their own spelling, so a floating .node-version major stays floating.
@plexus-ms packages run inside an app with immutable, provenance-attested versions: patch and minor merge unattended once CI is green.
The ansible-galaxy manager hands a github.com git URL to the github-tags datasource verbatim, which resolves only owner/repo.
The release train: ci-cd workflow refs run in tenant CI next to its secrets, the plexus.platform collection runs as root on tenant hosts. A human reads the diff; never automerged.

The app is the unit of deployment (§ 8.2 PLX): the images in one app's compose file move as one PR, so one merge is one deploy and its services never run mismatched versions. The group is named after the app directory, apps/<app>/.
A node major moves the runtime of every app in the repo at once: it waits for approval on the dependency dashboard.
